title: atalantia scandens
intro: Atalantia scandens, commonly known as the Chinese box myrtle or Atalantia, is a species of flowering plant in the family Rutaceae. It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Atalantia scandens include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as reducing pain, inflammation, and improving cardiovascular health. The health benefits of Atalantia scandens include its potential to treat fever, diarrhea, and respiratory infections, as well as its ability to lower blood pressure and cholesterol levels.
